description:
Lower Your Cortisol | Sitar Instrumental | 1.5 Hours to Feel Calm Again

Some days the body stays on alert long after the reason has gone. This is ninety minutes to tell it the day is over.

This slow Indian sitar music is designed to lower stress and help you feel calm again: long, warm notes with plenty of space that slow your breathing and settle the body.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of gentle sitar over a soft tanpura drone, with no drums and no vocals.

▶ Stay calm — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for evening stress relief, a cortisol reset after a long day, winding down after work, meditation, breathwork, yoga nidra, a warm bath, reading, or the hour before bed.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sitar with tanpura drone
Raga: Pilu (a light, soothing evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Tender, slow, settling
Atmosphere: Lamplight, a warm cup, the alert finally switching off
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Sit somewhere soft, hold something warm and breathe out longer than you breathe in. Let each long sitar note settle the body a little further.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Switching off
9:00 A warm cup
18:00 Slower breath
27:00 Shoulders soften
36:00 The alert fades
45:00 Calm returning
54:00 Settled body
1:03:00 Quiet mind
1:12:00 Feel calm again
1:21:00 Rest

⏱ BEST FOR
• Stress relief
• Cortisol reset
• Evening wind-down
• Meditation
• Breathwork
• Yoga nidra
• A warm bath
• Reading
• Before bed
